scenarios.name: enters-tapped-without-a-basic-land
scenarios.why: The land's own enters-the-battlefield replacement makes it enter tapped unless its controller controls a basic land at that moment; played with no other land controlled, it enters tapped.

scenarios.name: enters-untapped-with-a-basic-land
scenarios.why: Controlling a basic land (a Forest) at the moment the replacement applies, Ba Sing Se enters untapped.

scenarios.name: earthbend-2-animates-a-land
scenarios.why: The {2}{G}, {T} ability earthbends 2: the targeted land I control becomes a 0/0 creature with haste that's still a land, and gets two +1/+1 counters, so it is a 2/2 land creature with haste.
